entries.zh: 疑为绞合、混合或纠缠；具体词义存疑
entries.en: Possibly to twist, mix, or entangle; the exact sense is uncertain.
entries.notes: L 栏作“Burbelo.”；H 栏作“絞 糅 [疑:糅/糾]”，汉字辨读及其与词头的对应关系存疑。

entries.zh: 嘲弄、戏弄
entries.en: To mock or make fun of.
entries.notes: H 栏作“賤 [疑:賤/賊]”，汉字辨读未定。

entries.zh: 嘲弄、戏弄；汉字栏的具体词形存疑
entries.en: To mock or make fun of; the exact Chinese expression is uncertain.
entries.notes: H 栏作“賤 [疑:賤/賊] 滚”，首字辨读未定。

entries.zh: 嘲弄、戏弄；具体词形和词义存疑
entries.en: To mock or make fun of; the exact expression and sense are uncertain.
entries.notes: H 栏仅有“滚”，M 栏作“cǔn cǒg cǔn.”，R 栏作“cùn.”；对应关系未明。

entries.zh: 以言语调笑、嘲弄
entries.en: To mock or tease in words.

entries.zh: 戏弄、作弄
entries.en: To tease or make game of.
entries.notes: L 栏尾词疑作“vuihan/bruhan”，具体指称未明。

entries.zh: 嘲弄、戏弄；“創”的具体词义存疑
entries.en: To mock or make sport of; the exact sense of “創” here is uncertain.
entries.notes: H 栏作“創”；基本释义依据 L 栏，汉字栏的具体用法未定。

entries.zh: 以手戏弄、逗弄；与恋人有关的用法存疑
entries.en: To tease or play with the hands; the reference to a lover is uncertain.
entries.notes: L 栏末词疑作“enamorade/enamorada”；R 栏字面为“hȳ”。

entries.zh: 戏耍、玩弄；嘲弄
entries.en: to mock, ridicule; to tease and make sport of
entries.notes: M 栏末记有“mofar”，与 L 栏词形相同；其在音栏中的性质未定。

entries.zh: 戏谑、打诨；嘲弄
entries.en: to banter and jest; to mock, ridicule
entries.notes: H 栏第二字疑作“譚/談”，字形未定。

entries.zh: 与恋人有关的戏弄；具体用法存疑
entries.en: Mocking or teasing associated with lovers; the exact usage is uncertain.
entries.notes: H 栏第二字疑作“姦/姣”；L 栏作“Burlar vt los enamorade.”；R 栏字面为“hȳ cǎn”。

entries.zh: 反讽地嘲弄；以讥讽的话戏弄
entries.en: To mock or speak with irony.
entries.notes: H 栏疑作“挸/挩”，字形未定。

entries.zh: 讥刺耍弄、冷嘲热讽地戏弄
entries.en: to taunt and mock ironically
entries.notes: H 栏首字疑作“挸/挩”，字形未定。

entries.zh: 以眼部动作嘲弄；“目白”所指的具体动作存疑
entries.en: To mock by making gestures with the eyes; the exact gesture denoted by “目白” is uncertain.
entries.notes: H 栏作“目 白”；M 栏第二音节声调标为 T99（污損難辨）。

entries.zh: 吐舌、伸舌头作怪相
entries.en: to put out the tongue (in mockery)
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节声调标记 T99 污損难辨；舌吐即吐舌，与西语栏'sacando la lengua'相合，记 low。

entries.zh: 侮弄、戏弄；嘲弄者
entries.en: To mock or make game of; a mocker or scoffer.
entries.notes: L 栏作“Burlarse y Burlon.”，M 栏另记“Bufar.”，R 栏作“cūn bù lòng.”；音栏与汉字栏的对应关系未明。

entries.zh: 嘲弄、戏弄；“合滚”的具体词义存疑
entries.en: To mock or make fun of; the exact meaning of “合滚” is uncertain.
entries.notes: H 栏作“合 滚”；M、R 栏均作“cóg cùn.”，具体词义未定。

entries.zh: 嘲弄；带有戏谑、嘲弄意味的话
entries.en: To mock; words used in jest or mockery.
entries.notes: H 栏作“清 談”，与 L 栏的具体对应关系未明。

entries.zh: 嘲弄、戏弄；具体词义存疑
entries.en: To mock or make sport of; the exact sense is uncertain.
entries.notes: H 栏作“當 酒”，M 栏作“hōng zoà tǒg.”，R 栏作“tāng zà”；音栏与汉字栏的对应关系及具体词义未明。

entries.zh: 以言语嘲弄、斗嘴；汉字栏作“打口鼓”
entries.en: To mock or banter with words; the Chinese column reads “打口鼓”.
entries.notes: H 栏作“打 口 鼓”，M 栏作“bòa chǔy con tǒg.”，R 栏作“tò guěn cùn.”；音栏与汉字栏的对应关系未明。

entries.zh: 侮弄尊长、冒犯长辈
entries.en: to mock and insult one's elders
